question: Can a bull-only extra-beta sleeve increase upside when downside semivolatility, rather than total or absolute portfolio tail risk, has authority only over the incremental sleeve while corrected BRRK-0011 remains frozen?

parent_evidence.ASYM-BETA-0021: Rejected as structurally inert because the absolute 20% CVaR/CDaR budget repeatedly estimated safe total scale below 1 and therefore prohibited any >1x overlay.
parent_evidence.BRRK-0009: Exact label-free p_bad contains left-tail information but previously harmed upside when allowed to scale the whole portfolio.
parent_evidence.legacy_dynamic_beta: Positive-side beta used a frozen 45% annualized total-volatility anchor; 0022 preserves the 45% anchor but changes only the risk measure from total RV to downside semivolatility and limits its authority to extra beta.

frozen_inputs.underlying_alpha: frozen V1 selection and relative asset weights, gross normalized to <=1 before BRRK scaling
frozen_inputs.state_model: existing PCA4 four-state variational HMM, 600-day minimum training, 30-day refit
frozen_inputs.trend_score: existing BTC 20/60/120/240-day score with weights 0.15/0.25/0.30/0.30, range [-1,1]
frozen_inputs.p_bad: exact migrated BRRK-0009 causal raw-state P(conditional V1 daily mean < 0)

only_structural_change_vs_0021.remove: absolute 20-day CVaR/CDaR safe-total-scale gate from extra-beta authority
only_structural_change_vs_0021.replace_with: 30-day BTC downside semivolatility scaler applied only to the extra sleeve
only_structural_change_vs_0021.downside_semivolatility: sqrt(mean(min(BTC daily log return, 0)^2) over the latest 30 completed daily returns) * sqrt(365)
only_structural_change_vs_0021.downside_scaler: min(1, 0.45 / downside_semivol30); if downside_semivol30 is zero, scaler=1
only_structural_change_vs_0021.permission: final_extra is forced to zero whenever corrected BRRK core scale is below 1.0
only_structural_change_vs_0021.asset_allocation: scale the frozen V1 vector uniformly; no SOL or other asset-specific tilt

strict_current_router.all_incremental_exposure: native Hyperliquid perp funding, including incremental BTC

required_validation: Reconstructed BRRK core held weights must match persisted BRRK0011_BASELINE within 1e-5 max absolute weight error.
Reconstructed BRRK strict-router equity must match deterministic ROUTER-PNL-0005 reconstruction within $0.05 max absolute equity error.
The final gross exposure after banding must never exceed 1.50 + numerical tolerance.
required_outputs: monthly decision diagnostics including trend, p_bad, downside semivol, downside scaler and extra scale
extra activation frequency and exposure distribution
prohibited: no post-result search over downside window length
no post-result search over the 45% anchor
no change to the 0.50 extra cap or 1.50 gross cap
no p_bad threshold or nonlinear transform
no SOL-specific or other asset-specific tilt
no reinterpretation as untouched out-of-sample or production evidence
stopping_rule: Run this specification once. Do not tune it on the same historical window. If it is economically unhelpful after native funding, reject it. If it produces materially higher funding-aware upside without an obviously unacceptable left-tail deterioration, it may only qualify for a separately preregistered forward-shadow experiment.
